mapper.insert: insert into replay_session ( session_name, symbol, exchange_code, mode, source_type, status, source_trace_id, replay_trace_id ) values ( #{sessionName}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{mode}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{sourceTraceId}, #{replayTraceId} )
insert into replay_event ( session_id, trace_id, event_type, symbol, exchange_code, payload_json ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{traceId}, #{eventType}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{payloadJson} )

insert into paper_trade_order ( trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, side, mode, order_ref, quote_amount, status, order_status ) values ( #{traceId}, #{exchangeCode}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{mode}, #{orderRef}, #{quoteAmount}, #{status}, #{orderStatus} )

insert into shadow_decision_log ( trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, mode, action, side, confidence, summary_reason, model_code, model_provider, prompt_source, binding_template_code, fallback_template_code, resolved_template_code, prompt_template_fallback_used, execution_status, order_status ) values ( #{traceId}, #{exchangeCode}, #{symbol}, #{mode}, #{action}, #{side}, #{confidence}, #{summaryReason}, #{modelCode}, #{modelProvider}, #{promptSource}, #{bindingTemplateCode}, #{fallbackTemplateCode}, #{resolvedTemplateCode}, #{promptTemplateFallbackUsed}, #{executionStatus}, #{orderStatus} )
mapper.select: select id, session_name, symbol, exchange_code, mode, source_type, status, source_trace_id, replay_trace_id from replay_session order by id desc
select id, trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, side, mode, order_ref, quote_amount, status, status as execution_status, order_status from paper_trade_order order by id desc

select id, trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, mode, action, side, confidence, summary_reason, model_code, model_provider, prompt_source, binding_template_code, fallback_template_code, resolved_template_code, prompt_template_fallback_used, execution_status, order_status from shadow_decision_log order by id desc

select id, trace_id as traceId, event_type as eventType, symbol, exchange_code as exchangeCode, payload_json as payloadJson, created_at as createdAt from event_raw where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id asc
select id, trace_id as traceId, symbol, signal_type as signalType, feature_json as featureJson, created_at as createdAt from signal_event where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id asc

select dr.id, dr.trace_id as traceId, dr.symbol, dr.mode, dr.action, dr.confidence, dr.summary_reason as summaryReason, dr.model_code as modelCode, dr.model_provider as modelProvider, dr.prompt_source as promptSource, dr.binding_template_code as bindingTemplateCode, dr.fallback_template_code as fallbackTemplateCode, dr.resolved_template_code as resolvedTemplateCode, dr.prompt_template_fallback_used as promptTemplateFallbackUsed, case when dr.execution_status is not null and dr.execution_status != '' then lower(dr.execution_status) when eo.status is not null and eo.status != '' then lower(eo.status) when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end as executionStatus, coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) as orderStatus, dr.created_at as createdAt from decision_run dr left join exchange_order eo on eo.id = ( select max(inner_eo.id) from exchange_order inner_eo where inner_eo.trace_id = dr.trace_id ) where dr.trace_id = #{traceId} order by dr.id desc limit 1

select id, trace_id as traceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, side, mode, order_ref as orderRef, action, order_type as orderType, position_side as positionSide, reduce_only as reduceOnly, td_mode as tdMode, leverage, limit_price as limitPrice, quantity_base as quantityBase, okx_enhanced_execution as okxEnhancedExecution, case when status is not null and status != '' then lower(status) when order_status = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when order_status = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when order_status = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when order_status = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when order_status = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when order_status = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when order_status = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when order_status = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end as status, case when status is not null and status != '' then lower(status) when order_status = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when order_status = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when order_status = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when order_status = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when order_status = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when order_status = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when order_status = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when order_status = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end as executionStatus, order_status as orderStatus, created_at as createdAt from exchange_order where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id desc limit 1

select id, trace_id as traceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, side, position_side as positionSide, order_ref as orderRef, trade_id as tradeId, fill_price as fillPrice, fill_quantity as fillQuantity, fee, fee_ccy as feeCcy, is_maker as isMaker, exec_type as execType, realized_pnl as realizedPnl, filled_at as filledAt, raw_payload as rawPayload, created_at as createdAt from exchange_fill where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id asc

select eo.trace_id as traceId, eo.exchange_code as exchangeCode, eo.symbol, eo.mode, eo.action, eo.side, case lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) end as positionSide, eo.order_ref as orderRef, pcl.change_type as changeType, ef.fill_price as fillPrice, ef.fill_quantity as fillQuantity, case when eo.action in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then prev.entry_price when eo.action in ('OPEN_LONG', 'OPEN_SHORT', 'ADD_LONG', 'ADD_SHORT') then ef.fill_price else null end as openPrice, case when eo.action in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then ef.fill_price else null end as closePrice, ps.entry_price as entryPrice, ps.position_quantity as positionQuantity, case when eo.action in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') and prev.entry_price is not null and ef.fill_price is not null and pcl.before_quantity is not null and pcl.after_quantity is not null then round( ( case when case lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) end = 'short' then prev.entry_price - ef.fill_price else ef.fill_price - prev.entry_price end ) * ( case when pcl.before_quantity > pcl.after_quantity then pcl.before_quantity - pcl.after_quantity else 0 end ), 8 ) else 0 end as realizedPnl, case when eo.status is not null and eo.status != '' then lower(eo.status) when eo.order_status = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when eo.order_status = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when eo.order_status = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when eo.order_status = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when eo.order_status = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when eo.order_status = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when eo.order_status = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when eo.order_status = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end as executionStatus, eo.order_status as orderStatus, coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) as createdAt from exchange_order eo left join exchange_fill ef on ef.id = ( select max(inner_ef.id) from exchange_fill inner_ef where inner_ef.trace_id = eo.trace_id and inner_ef.order_ref = eo.order_ref ) left join position_snapshot ps on ps.id = ( select max(inner_ps.id) from position_snapshot inner_ps where inner_ps.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_change_log pcl on pcl.id = ( select max(inner_pcl.id) from position_change_log inner_pcl where inner_pcl.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_snapshot prev on prev.id = ( select max(inner_prev.id) from position_snapshot inner_prev where inner_prev.exchange_code = coalesce(ps.exchange_code, eo.exchange_code) and inner_prev.symbol = coalesce(ps.symbol, eo.symbol) and case lower(inner_prev.side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(inner_prev.side) end = case lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) end and (ps.id is null or inner_prev.id < ps.id) ) where eo.trace_id = #{traceId} and ef.id is not null order by coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) desc, eo.id desc limit 1
select id, trace_id as traceId, rule_code as ruleCode, reason, created_at as createdAt from risk_guard_hit where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id asc

select id, trace_id as traceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end as side, position_quantity as positionQuantity, entry_price as entryPrice, unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl, created_at as createdAt from position_snapshot where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id desc limit 1

select id, trace_id as traceId, mode, account_equity as accountEquity, unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl, realized_pnl as realizedPnl, daily_pnl as dailyPnl, max_drawdown_pct as maxDrawdownPct, peak_account_equity as peakAccountEquity, created_at as createdAt from pnl_snapshot where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id desc limit 1

select id, channel_id as channelId, trace_id as traceId, channel_type as channelType, channel_name as channelName, title, content, status, retry_count as retryCount, error_msg as errorMsg, recipient, template_id as templateId, template_vars as templateVars, send_time as sendTime, ext_data as extData, remark, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime from notify_record where trace_id = #{traceId} order by create_time desc, id desc

select id, trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, mode, action, side, confidence, summary_reason, model_code, model_provider, prompt_source, binding_template_code, fallback_template_code, resolved_template_code, prompt_template_fallback_used, execution_status, order_status from shadow_decision_log where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id desc limit 1
